purpose: Every campaign difference from the organizer frontier that is NOT an editablePaths entry and NOT campaign-owned scaffolding must be declared here, with the obligation that keeps it honest. senpai/verify-trusted-parity.sh fails on any undeclared drift.
notes: AGENTS.md is campaign-owned on purpose: the campaign rewrite is wrapped in <!-- SENPAI-CAMPAIGN-BEGIN --> and replaces the inherited Laguna/DFlash prose with a Qwen-only guide. It is not organizer drift.
Widening the allow-list to Tests/* would let a future sync hide real trusted-test drift. Declare each path individually instead.
organizerBlob pins the blob we reviewed. If the organizer changes that file in a later frontier, this gate fails on purpose so the overlay is re-reviewed instead of silently reapplied.
campaignBlob is informational only. It differs by branch: the trace seam and the QMV cost-curve test live on senpai/qwen38-mtp-r1, not on main.

overlays.why: The organizer writes #expect(cond, "a" + "b"), which fails Swift type checking, so `swift test` will not compile at all. The campaign rewrites the message as a multiline literal. Behaviour is unchanged; this is a compile repair, not a test relaxation.
Campaign-authored QMV cost-curve test. Absent upstream. Verified to compile against frontier-exact sources.
Wires the trusted forwardsWorkerStderr drain to the local mtp-timed verb so MLX_QWEN_MTP_TRACE=1 traces are readable. 9 insertions / 1 deletion.
overlays.obligation: The seam MUST stay ANDed with !officialRun (main.swift:2319). Checking the whole expression, not just the token `officialRun`, so the guard tests the gating code and cannot be satisfied by a comment that merely mentions it. A traced run is instrumented and can never be a timing arm.
